title: quassia praecox
intro: Quassia praecox, commonly known as Quassia, is a tropical plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help in treating various conditions like fever, cough, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Quassia praecox include its ability to stimulate the digestive system, relieve flatulence, and act as a natural insecticide. The bioactive constituents of Quassia praecox include quassin, quassinoids, and limonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential anti-cancer and anti-parasitic activities.
